name: agent-phaser
description: Skills for building, debugging and proving Phaser 4 games from a coding agent: project setup and the scene and fixed-step structure, the WebGL renderer and its filters, worlds bigger than the screen, physics, motion, pixel-exact UI, input, audio and architecture across games, with browser probes, install-time patch scripts and a Playwright test harness that back the claims. Pairs with agent-sprites atlases, agent-meshes models and agent-beeps sounds and music in a Phaser game. Choosing an engine and importing assets into other engines are in the agent-engine plugin.
